bandReport.notes: Footers read and confirmed Series D on every page: ( 2 - D ), ( 3 - D ), ( 6 - D ), ( 7 - D ), all with TFDD-B-AGT at foot left. The cover (idx 0, footer '( 1 - D )') carries the boxed series letter D, TBC TFDD-B-AGT and booklet no. 1120556 — instructions only, no questions. NUMBERING JUMP ACROSS THE MISSING PAGES: printed page 3 ENDS at Q20 and printed page 6 BEGINS at Q37, so Q21-Q36 — SIXTEEN questions — sat on the absent printed pages 4 and 5 and have no source in this scan. Not renumbered. The jump is corroborated by the Directions blocks rather than only by adjacency: the 'next 10 items' block on printed 3 opens at Q11, so it closes exactly at Q20, and printed 6 opens at the very top of both columns with nothing stranded above (Q37 left, a fresh 'next 05 items' Directions right). No Directions premise is lost across the gap: Q37/38 and Q39/40 each carry their full instruction inline, so they are self-sufficient. SEAM AFTER: printed 8 (idx 5, not in my band) is the HINDI verso opening 'भाग - B' at Q51, and printed 9 opens 'PART - B' at Q51 in English — so Part A ends at Q50 on printed 7 and nothing is stranded between my last page and the next band. RIGHT EDGE OF THE SCAN IS CLIPPED on p2 and p3 (the photograph loses the printed right margin, not a render crop — Set D is rendered with no clip). It cost STEM text only, never an option: Q9 'in spite o[f]', Q10 'everyone'[s]', Q16 'fallaciou[s]', Q17 'to t[he]' and 'discover[ed]', Q18 'somewh[at]', and Q19, where the UNDERLINED TARGET WORD itself is cut mid-word at 'somb…' (verified at 5x — the scan genuinely stops there). All 34 questions have all four options fully legible. Pen marking is heavy throughout (circled options on every page, plus a signature and the date 18/09/26 scrawled across Q43's option block) — ignored entirely, and it obscured no option text. Deviation from my dispatch note, reported rather than resolved silently: it described p6/p7 as carrying 'sentence-improvement items'; Q46-50 are in fact 'four sentences, one of which is grammatically correct — select the correct sentence', which is a different item type. The PQRS reorder items are as described.
